usd_reason: The dollar had its worst week in over 3 months amid Fed doubts
gold_reason: Lower US Treasury yields make gold more attractive
indices_reason: Investors are awaiting fresh economic data to make a move
lead_story: The US Treasury yields are falling as oil prices plunge on Iran de-escalation hopes, the dollar is also facing downward pressure after its worst week in over 3 months, and the Fed is under pressure to act on inflation, which is currently at its lowest in years, causing uncertainty in the market, the joint action on the yen by Tokyo and Washington is also being closely watched, and overall the market is in a wait-and-see mode awaiting fresh economic data
